**ValidateOwnerFields.java** — reads `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, normalizes address in place via `AddressNormalizer`, then requires firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone (throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException` listing missing fields → 400). Publishes body via `Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated`.
```java
public void service(@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated)
        throws MissingOwnerFieldsException {
    if (request.getAddress() != null) {
        request.setAddress(AddressNormalizer.normalize(request.getAddress()));
    }
    List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
    require(errors, "firstName", request.getFirstName());
    require(errors, "lastName", request.getLastName());
    require(errors, "address", request.getAddress());
    require(errors, "city", request.getCity());
    require(errors, "telephone", request.getTelephone());
    if (!errors.isEmpty()) {
        throw new MissingOwnerFieldsException(errors);
    }
    validated.set(request);
}
```

**NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java** — mutates `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` telephone to E.164 via `E164Telephone.normalize` (throws `InvalidTelephoneException` → 400).
```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request) throws InvalidTelephoneException {
    request.setTelephone(E164Telephone.normalize(request.getTelephone()));
}
```

**NormalizeOwnerEmail.java** — optional email; if present must match `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$` else `InvalidEmailException` (400); stores trimmed lower-case.

**ResolveRegistrationDate.java** — computes effective registration date (supplied or `LocalDate.now()`), rolls Sat/Sun forward to Monday (does NOT skip holidays), publishes `Out<LocalDate> registrationDate`.
```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<LocalDate> registrationDate) {
    LocalDate effective = request.getRegistrationDate() != null
            ? request.getRegistrationDate() : LocalDate.now();
    while (effective.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY
            || effective.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {
        effective = effective.plusDays(1);
    }
    registrationDate.set(effective);
}
```

**EnsureUniqueTelephone.java** — scans `ownerRepository.findAll()`, normalizes each existing telephone to E.164 (skipping invalid ones), throws `DuplicateTelephoneException` (409) on match.

**EnsureUniqueHousehold.java** — rejects if an existing owner shares normalized lastName + normalized address (`DuplicateHouseholdException` 409); bypassed when `request.getSharesHousehold()` is true.

**EnsureCityCapacity.java** — `CITY_CAPACITY = 50`; counts existing owners with same city (case-insensitive), throws `CityAtCapacityException` (409) at 50+.

**EnsureDailyLimit.java** — `DAILY_LIMIT = 100`; counts existing owners whose `registrationDate` equals the resolved `@Val LocalDate registrationDate`, throws `DailyLimitReachedException` (429) at 100+.

**BuildOwner.java** — maps DTO to entity via `OwnerMapper.toOwner`, publishes `Out<Owner> built`.
```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, Out<Owner> built) {
    built.set(ownerMapper.toOwner(request));
}
```

**AssignHousehold.java** — when `sharesHousehold` true, derives a stable `H-` + first 6 bytes of SHA-256(lastName|address) hex id, back-fills it onto every matching existing owner (saving them) and sets it on the new owner.

**DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate.java** — applies the resolved `@Val LocalDate registrationDate` onto `@Val Owner owner` (overwriting any raw weekend date).
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, @Val LocalDate registrationDate) {
    owner.setRegistrationDate(registrationDate);
}
```

**AssignCustomerCode.java** — sets `customerCode` = `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` where NNNN = (count of owners in same city, case-insensitive) + 1, zero-padded to 4.
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    String city = owner.getCity();
    String city3 = city.substring(0, Math.min(3, city.length())).toUpperCase();
    String lastName = owner.getLastName();
    String last3 = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
    int sequence = (int) ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
            .filter(o -> city.equalsIgnoreCase(o.getCity()))
            .count() + 1;
    owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
}
```

**AssignNamesakeCount.java** — sets `namesakeCount` = number of existing owners sharing same firstName+lastName (case-insensitive), computed before save so never counts itself.

```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    ownerRepository.save(owner);
}
```

**RespondWithOwnerCreated.java** — maps to `OwnerDto`, responds `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` and the DTO body.
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerMapper ownerMapper,
        ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<OwnerDto>> response) {
    OwnerDto dto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
    response.send(ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/owners/" + owner.getId())).body(dto));
}
```
